title: Chorded skills (5 / 6): Arisen vs possessed pawn
intro: Controller in hand. Open ground. First you play the Arisen normally, then the possessed main pawn, pressing the same chords. This records exactly what the game's input reports each frame.

steps.text: AS THE ARISEN: hold L1, press SQUARE+CROSS together. Release all. Do it 3 times, slowly.
AS THE ARISEN: hold L1, press TRIANGLE+CIRCLE together. Release all. 3 times.
AS THE PAWN: hold L1, press SQUARE+CROSS together. Release all. 3 times.
AS THE PAWN: hold L1, press TRIANGLE+CIRCLE together. Release all. 3 times.

probes.a_on:
if not ACTS then
  ACTS = {}
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.CharacterInput.Action")
  local gm = sdk.find_type_definition("app.CharacterInput"):get_method("getInputFlag")
  for _, f in ipairs(td:get_fields()) do
    if f:is_static() and f:get_name() ~= "value__" then
      local ok, id = pcall(f.get_data, f, nil)
      if ok and type(id) == "number" and id >= 0 and id < 63 then
        local flag = 1 << id
        local ok2, fv = pcall(gm.call, gm, nil, id)
        if ok2 and type(fv) == "number" and fv > 0 then flag = fv end
        ACTS[#ACTS + 1] = { f:get_name(), flag }
      end
    end
  end
end
local inp = H.ar_input(); if not inp then return nil end
local on = inp:get_field("ButtonOnFlags") or 0
local t = {}
for _, a in ipairs(ACTS) do if (on & a[2]) == a[2] and a[2] ~= 0 then t[#t + 1] = a[1] end end
return table.concat(t, "+")
